purpose: Additional Pattern development evaluation; no Pattern examples enter compared models.
ground_truth: Visual master-waveform/spectrogram provisional proposals, not independent human listening truth.
review_method: Native44.1kHz master excerpts. Exact waveform extrema and stereo power Hann2048/hop96 centred STFT; only raw waveforms determine onset brackets. All fixed cores retained. Named48kHz drums were hydrated under a60s bound but no reliable clock alignment was established; source values provide no label corroboration.

source_alignment.limitation: Opening drums are silent; middle correlation is weak; later periodic peaks have ambiguous competing lags. Master and named-drums recordings also differ in duration and musical content. No offset was accepted.

timing: Master seconds authoritative. Native source sample intervals and excerpt origins preserved; source onset coordinates null because no mapping was accepted. Midpoints represent manually read brackets, with explicit unknown regions kept separate.
unknown_policy: Unknown physical intervals must be excluded using the existing annotation response-window rule after lead acceptance; no threshold-specific changes. Recording-start uncertainty is retained. Provisional negative claims use master evidence, not named-source silence.
